intent: Increased body width, wheel track, and sensor size for improved stability and detection.
rationale: The telemetry from the last race indicated that the robot struggled with stability, as evidenced by a high number of line loss events (4 out of 8) and a significant rms error of 0.009138. To improve stability and control, I have decided to increase the body width to 0.18m (from 0.16m) and adjust the wheel track to 0.16m (from 0.15m). Additionally, I will increase the sensor size to 0.016m to enhance detection capabilities. These changes should further enhance the robot's balance and reduce line loss events, leading to better performance in future races.
